text: Catch-up block 35 is read: 25 of 25 notes amended, each with case.md and brief.md served whole in separate calls and the counts checked; from forsen on, under J's ruling that 350 words is a guide, earlier lines were no longer cut to fit, and notes average about 390 words (21 validator warnings, 0 errors). In this block the briefs most often showed the room's own words and habits reused on the canvas, restraint again sat beside members who wanted to strike, and decisions made in Discord came back only as reports. The head is rewritten at 2,967 words; the next leg reads block 36 from wales.
